title: Mutilated Ladies
question: Why did Jane cook John's wallet?

meanings.usage: 常指严重损坏物体的外观或完整性，也可指使身体致残
常用结构：despair of (doing) sth 对做某事不抱希望
不可数名词，常用搭配：in despair 陷入绝望
常用搭配：make a claim for sth 就某物提出索赔
指已订婚的男性，对应的女性形式为fiancee
不可数名词，常用搭配：for safekeeping 以妥善保管
不可数名词，常用搭配：to one's dismay 令某人惊愕的是
表示“灰烬”时常用复数形式ashes，不可数名词
后可直接接宾语，也可用于identify A as B 结构，指认出A是B
对应的男性形式为spokesman，复数形式为spokeswomen
主语通常为事件、故事等，表示内容和某人/事相关
常用结构：be concerned about 担忧...

phrases.usage: 表示“处理，应付”，后接问题、事件、人等作宾语

examples.en: The team deals with all kinds of customer complaints every day.
examples.zh: 这个团队每天处理各种各样的客户投诉。

examples.en: He is good at dealing with difficult situations.
examples.zh: 他擅长应对困难局面。

phrases.usage: 表示“变成灰烬”，属于turn to sth的固定搭配，指转化为某种形态

examples.en: The old books turned to ash in the big fire.
examples.zh: 那些旧书在大火中化成了灰烬。

examples.en: All his hopes turned to ash when he heard the bad news.
examples.zh: 听到这个坏消息时，他所有的希望都破灭了。

phrases.usage: 连词短语，引导条件状语从句，意为“只要”，相当于as long as

examples.en: So long as you work hard, you will pass the exam.
examples.zh: 只要你努力学习，你就会通过考试。

examples.en: We can go out so long as it doesn't rain.
examples.zh: 只要不下雨，我们就可以出门。

phrases.usage: 固定搭配，表示“为了妥善保管”，在句中作目的状语

examples.en: He gave his important documents to his lawyer for safekeeping.
examples.zh: 他把自己的重要文件交给律师妥善保管。

examples.en: I put the diamond necklace in the bank for safekeeping.
examples.zh: 我把钻石项链放在银行妥善保存。

phrases.usage: 常用表达，表示“似乎，看起来”，用于描述不确定的情况或主观推测

examples.en: It seems that no one knows what happened last night.
examples.zh: 似乎没有人知道昨晚发生了什么。

examples.en: It seems he is not interested in the plan at all.
examples.zh: 看起来他对这个计划一点都不感兴趣。

sentences.en: Has it ever happened to you?
Have you ever put your trousers in the washing machine and then remembered there was a large bank note in your back pocket?
sentences.zh: 你是否曾经把裤子放进洗衣机里，然后才想起你的后裤袋里有一张大额钞票？

sentences.en: When you rescued your trousers, did you find the note was whiter than white?
sentences.zh: 当你把裤子拿出来时，是否发现那张钞票比雪还白？

sentences.en: People who live in Britain needn't despair when they make mistakes like this (and a lot of people do)!
sentences.zh: 在英国居住的人们犯了这种错误不必绝望（而且很多人都会犯这种错误）！

sentences.en: Fortunately for them, the Bank of England has a team called Mutilated Ladies
sentences.zh: 对他们来说幸运的是，英格兰银行有一个名为“残钞处理小组”的团队，

sentences.en: which deals with claims from people who fed their money to a machine or to their dog.
sentences.zh: 处理那些把钱喂给机器或喂给狗的人提出的索赔。

sentences.en: Dogs, it seems, love to chew up money!
A recent case concerns Jane Butlin whose fiance, John, runs a successful furniture business.
sentences.zh: 最近有一件事是关于简·巴特林，她的未婚夫约翰经营着一家成功的家具公司。

sentences.en: John had a very good day and put his wallet containing ￡3, 000 into the microwave oven for safekeeping.
sentences.zh: 约翰那天生意很好，就把装有3000英镑的钱包放进了微波炉里，以求安全。

sentences.en: Then he and Jane went horse-riding.
When they got home, Jane cooked their dinner in the microwave oven and without realizing it, cooked her fiance's wallet as well.
sentences.zh: 他们到家后，简在微波炉里做了晚餐，并且在不知不觉中，也把她未婚夫的钱包给煮了。

sentences.en: Imagine their dismay when they found a beautifully-cooked wallet and notes turned to ash!
sentences.zh: 想象一下当他们发现一个“烹调精美”的钱包和变成灰烬的钞票时，他们的沮丧！

sentences.en: John went to see his bank manager who sent the remains of wallet and the money
sentences.zh: 约翰去见了银行经理，经理把钱包和钱的残余部分

sentences.en: to the special department of the Bank of England in Newcastle: the Mutilated Ladies!
sentences.zh: 送到了英格兰银行在纽卡斯尔的特别部门：残钞处理小组！

sentences.en: They examined the remains and John got all his money back.
sentences.zh: 他们检查了残余物，约翰拿回了他所有的钱。

sentences.en: 'So long as there's something to identify, we will give people their money back,' said a spokeswoman for the Bank.
sentences.zh: “只要有可识别的部分，我们就会把钱还给人们，”银行的一位女发言人说。

sentences.en: 'Last year, we paid ￡1.5 million on 21,000 claims.'
sentences.zh: “去年，我们为21000份索赔支付了150万英镑。”

exercises.prompt: “用于询问到目前为止是否发生过某件事，常和ever等词搭配使用，强调经历” 描述的是哪个语法点？
exercises.hint: Have/Has + 主语 + ever + 动词过去分词 + 其他?
options: 现在完成时的一般疑问句
虚拟语气在条件状语从句中的用法（与过去事实相反）
定冠词the的特指用法 (Definite Article 'the' for Specific Reference)
exercises.explain: 现在完成时的一般疑问句：Have/Has + 主语 + ever + 动词过去分词 + 其他?：常用于询问对方是否有过某种经历，肯定回答用Yes, 主语+have/has，否定回答用No, 主语+haven't/hasn't

source.title: 现在完成时的一般疑问句

选出下面句子的正确中文意思：

options: 这些平台延伸到海面以下100多英尺的深度。
一个糟糕的冬天，我们看着河水悄悄漫上了低洼的草地。
由当时一家名为微软的小公司开发。
exercises.explain: Then he and Jane went horse-riding. — 然后他和简去骑马了。

source.en: Then he and Jane went horse-riding.

grammar.title: 定语从句
grammar.definition: 在复合句中修饰名词或代词的从句，起到定语的作用，被修饰的词叫先行词，关系词连接先行词和从句
grammar.structure: 先行词 + 关系代词/关系副词 + 从句
grammar.usage: 当先行词是人时，常用who/that引导；先行词是物时，常用which/that引导；表示所属关系时用whose引导

examples.en: People who live in Britain needn't despair when they make mistakes like this.
examples.zh: 犯了这类错误的英国人完全不必绝望。

examples.en: A recent case concerns Jane Butlin whose fiance, John, runs a successful furniture business.
examples.zh: 最近的一个案例与简·巴特林有关，她的未婚夫约翰经营着一家生意兴隆的家具店。

grammar.title: 现在完成时的一般疑问句
grammar.definition: 用于询问到目前为止是否发生过某件事，常和ever等词搭配使用，强调经历
grammar.structure: Have/Has + 主语 + ever + 动词过去分词 + 其他?
grammar.usage: 常用于询问对方是否有过某种经历，肯定回答用Yes, 主语+have/has，否定回答用No, 主语+haven't/hasn't

examples.en: Have you ever put your trousers in the washing machine and then remembered there was a large bank note in your back pocket?
examples.zh: 你有没有过把裤子放进洗衣机，然后才想起后兜里还有一张大额钞票的经历？

examples.en: Has she ever travelled abroad alone?
examples.zh: 她有没有过独自出国旅行的经历？

patterns.pattern: Have you ever done sth and then done sth else?

original.en: Have you ever put your trousers in the washing machine and then remembered there was a large bank note in your back pocket?
original.zh: 你有没有过把裤子放进洗衣机，然后才想起后兜里还有一张大额钞票的经历？

examples.en: Have you ever fallen asleep in class and then woken up to find the teacher standing next to you?
examples.zh: 你有没有过在课堂上睡着，醒来时发现老师就站在你旁边的经历？

examples.en: Have you ever ordered a lot of food and then found you couldn't finish it?
examples.zh: 你有没有过点了很多食物，结果发现自己吃不完的经历？

original.en: People who live in Britain needn't despair when they make mistakes like this.
original.zh: 犯了这类错误的英国人完全不必绝望。

examples.en: You needn't despair when you meet difficulties in learning English.
examples.zh: 你在学习英语时遇到困难不必绝望。

examples.en: We needn't despair when the experiment fails the first time.
examples.zh: 第一次实验失败的时候我们不必绝望。

patterns.pattern: So long as..., sb will do sth.

original.en: So long as there's something to identify, we will give people their money back.
original.zh: 只要还有可以识别的东西，我们就会把钱还给当事人。

examples.en: So long as you keep trying, you will achieve your goal sooner or later.
examples.zh: 只要你不断尝试，你迟早会实现目标的。

examples.en: So long as we finish the work before Friday, we can have a three-day holiday.
examples.zh: 只要我们在周五前完成工作，我们就可以放三天假。
